title: Digital Lab: Get Started with Models in Microsoft Foundry to Build AI Apps
description:
In this hands-on lab, you will build a production-ready AI application using Microsoft Foundry, with no fine-tuning or deep machine learning expertise required. You will discover and select models, provision a Foundry project, and connect to a hosted model using the OpenAI SDK. You’ll implement a comment moderation workflow, compare model outputs, and package the solution as a hosted agent using Python, ready for real-world integration.

This is a self-paced, digitally-delivered lab experience that you complete on your own schedule. Click the 'Launch' button to start the lab, and then after authentication, follow the instructions listed on the lab page to complete the activity. For technical issues or support, please contact the support team via this link: https://skill.info/build26labsupport.
